title: The Download: Pelosi’s successor targets AI and data centers face power woes
summary: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. Nancy Pelosi’s replacement is ready to regulate AI —Grace Huckins As a California state senator, Scott Wiener authored legislation aimed at curbing the risks of advanced AI. Now, after winning a…
llm_summary: The newsletter notes that California’s new House Speaker, Scott Wiener—who succeeded Nancy Pelosi—plans to push forward AI regulation, building on his earlier state‑level bill that aimed to curb the risks of advanced AI systems. At the same time, data‑center operators are grappling with growing power‑supply challenges as demand for compute capacity spikes, highlighting the need for more resilient energy infrastructure.
